title: Pectin-encapsulated amorphous naringenin with enhanced aqueous solubility prepared by simple coacervation and precipitation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00705D, Paper

Weerapha Panatdasirisuk, Weerachai Chantana, Adisak Hawan, Phimonwan Wongjeen, Verawat Champreda
This study presents a sustainable approach for enhancing the solubility and processability of naringenin, a poorly water-soluble bioactive flavonoid, through fruit peel-inspired encapsulation.
